_comment: Overheard rumours (Story 8.5). {place} = a world biome, {faction} = a rival guild — filled from factions.json / world data (MOD-7). Fallbacks used if data is missing.
lines: They say the roads through {place} aren't safe after dark.
Word is the {faction} is recruiting sellswords again.
A caravan went missing crossing {place}, or so they claim.
Someone found old ruins deep in {place} — untouched, they swear.
The {faction} banner was seen flying where it had no business being.
Folk out by {place} have been paying good coin for guild work.
There's talk of something stirring in {place}.
A stranger's been asking after adventurers, headed for {place}.
They whisper the {faction} lost a whole company in {place}.
Merchants won't cross {place} anymore without an armed escort.
